title: Design System: Azure Backup operations review

components.name: Full-file action
components.description: Complete download, independent of visible filters.

components.name: Local filter
components.description: Native, labeled search inside the recorded snapshot.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Job ID / entity text<input class="ds-field" type="search" placeholder="Filter the recorded jobs"></label>

components.name: Unknown state
components.description: Named uncertainty, not a healthy zero.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.description: Progressive inline native evidence; no modal or source request.
components.html:
Evidence / errors
SIMULATED source text; not a live receipt.

narrative.overview: The implemented system is a neutral evidence sheet inside a charcoal mast and sparse customer-selected yellow navigation. It is an operating surface, not a score dashboard. Literal dates, native states and readable source disclosure carry its authority.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ruled ledgers rather than nested metric cards.
Brand yellow independent of named operational severity.
Familiar native controls and inline source disclosure.
System typography and full offline behavior.

rules.name: Brand Is Not Severity
rules.body: Yellow marks branding/navigation and the primary full-file action. It never means a warning, successful backup or grade.

rules.name: Dark-on-Yellow
rules.body: The brand field uses charcoal text, not white. All evidence uses contrast-preserving text on neutral or named semantic washes.

dos: Do preserve the supplied yellow/charcoal identity in generic and private copies.
Do keep dates, uncertainty and source evidence visible before conclusions.
Do use full native item/vault identities and distinct named semantic states.
Do keep mobile controls keyboard-native and at least 44px high.
donts: Don't use brand yellow as operational warning severity.
Don't invent scores, success rates, incident outcomes or decorative charts.
Don't turn a logo, source presence or a blank ledger into health evidence.
Don't add external assets, libraries, live polling or remote links to source text.
